messages:
Ravi: Heads up 1 Helion just pinged CS about a weird duplicate dedicated burst line on their March invoice. They see identical token counts billed across two pools.
Nina: Can you drop the invoice id and line numbers? I can fetch the raw meter entries.
Ravi: INV-2031-HEL-03 lines 9 & 10. Helion says both lines list 91,640 tokens for the same model request window.
billing-bot: Quick meter extract for INV-2031-HEL-03:
```
line,customer,model,tokens,pool,region
9,helion,redwood-13b,91640,dedicated-core-usw2,us-west-2
10,helion,redwood-13b,91640,dedicated-failover-eu,eu-central-1
```
Jorge: That's suspicious. I can join request ids between pools. Standby.
Jorge: Found ~18,328 matching request_ids that appear in both pools between 2026-03-09T01:55 and 2026-03-09T02:20 UTC. Looks like a fallback retry path retriggered when pool assignment changed mid-rollout.
Nina: Do we have unit rates on that invoice for burst vs reserved? Need to compute credit.
Ravi: Burst rate = $6.00 per 1k tokens (invoice meta). Reserved baseline different but these were billed as burst lines.
Jorge: Duplicate token count = 18,328. Calculation: 18.328 * $6.00 = $109.968 -> round to $110.
Customer Success: CS wants a one-line memo and a provisional credit while billing audits. Can we issue a goodwill credit for $110 and follow up with final numbers?
Nina: Before issuing, we should confirm none of these token hits were legitimately routed to different charge classes (e.g., reserved vs partner). I checked: both entries are flagged as burst in metering.
Ravi: OK approve provisional $110 credit. I'll draft the memo: apology, brief root cause (fallback + rollout mapping change), and ETA 48 hours for final audit.
Jorge: Also raising an infra ticket to prevent double-metering during vmap updates. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/ticket/BILL-7621
Customer Success: Helion said they'd take the provisional credit but asked for the final audit CSV. CS: can we attach the request-id join and a note about rounding?
Nina: Will attach CSV with matched request-ids and token counts. I'll include the raw meter extracts.
Ravi: Great. Marking invoice as PENDING-CREDIT and routing to accounting to post memo.
Jorge: Follow-up: adding an alert to deployment pipelines to warn on vmap_version mismatches during traffic cutover.
Customer Success: Helion responded :thumbsup:, thanked us for the quick turnaround.
notes: Conforms to Slack thread schema; no title field per agents.md
